# bla5k — Best AI Tools Directory 2026

> bla5k is a curated, human-reviewed directory of the best AI tools, apps and
> communities. Every tool has an in-depth review: what it does, pricing, free
> tiers, pros/cons, comparison tables, FAQs and plain-language explainers.
> We cover AI chat, coding, design, video & audio, education, writing, agents
> and no-code builders. Updated weekly. Unbiased — affiliate links disclosed.
